sources_tried: Seed file salt-lake-city.json (Google Maps): worked. Most entries are remodelers, plumbers or stores; Beacon, Rex Williams, Cannon Sales, Robert I. Merrill and Architectural Building Supply were the plausible ones.
Rex Williams site (rexwilliamsd10.com): returned an empty page; the Clutch profile worked.
Division 10 Sales (division10sales.com): worked, but it's a nationwide shipper with a 704 (North Carolina) phone that mentions no installation, so it's excluded despite the Ogden Maps listing.
Scranton Products product specialist page: worked; it lists only a regional rep (person, no company) covering UT, so no dealer was added.
Bobrick find-a-rep: form-based locator, no static results.
ASI (asi-globalpartitions.com find-a-rep): redirect only, not followed up.
Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco locators: not tried (search and time budget).
The Blue Book: blocked (403) on the search page and the iProView profile.
WebSearch (8 of 8 used): toilet partition installation SLC, Division 10 Utah, nearby cities, Rex Williams, Robert I. Merrill. Results were mostly One Point Partitions (an online supplier) and Beacon.

Innergy Interiors (innergy-interiors.pages.dev): says it supplies and installs Division 10 including toilet partitions in UT, but it's based in El Paso, TX (phone 915-353-2008), well past the 120-mile limit, so it's excluded; a possible regional lead if the range is relaxed.
Yelp/BBB: no relevant listings surfaced in search.

candidates.name: Beacon Commercial Door and Lock (Beacon CDL)
candidates.partition_evidence: The Salt Lake City location page says 'Services can include pre-installed hardware and onsite installation of doors, hardware, bathroom partitions, and bathroom accessories.' The portfolio lists bathroom partitions on the Layton Temple and Pocatello Temple projects, but those entries don't say who installed them.
red_flags: Distributor that sells bathroom partitions itself (Division 10 through its Rex Williams division), so there is a high risk of it buying around us
Door, frame and hardware business first; partition installation is one service among many
candidates.reason: A commercial Division 08/10 distributor in South Salt Lake that says it offers onsite installation of bathroom partitions and serves Utah and the Intermountain West. It also supplies partitions, so it is a competitor as well as a possible installer.

license.name: Beacon Commercial Door and Lock (Beacon CDL)
license.registry: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) Licensee Lookup and Verification System (secure.utah.gov/llv)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. You can only search the DOPL lookup by submitting a POST form, and that form carries a Google reCAPTCHA field (g-recaptcha-response). It can't be queried automatically, so the license status is unknown. Confirm manually at secure.utah.gov/llv under the CONTRACTOR profession. Salt Lake City issues commercial permits only to state-licensed contractors and has no separate public contractor registry, so the DOPL record is the one to check. The company site (https://beaconcdl.com/) shows no Utah contractor license number. Its footer gives the location as Salt Lake, UT 84115, which is consistent with South Salt Lake. It lists Bathroom Partitions as a Division 10 product category and has a generic Installation link.

No installation is mentioned on its own site. Since 2019 it has been part of Beacon CDL, which offers partition installation.
red_flags: Supplier and distributor of partitions (buy-around risk)
The same company as Beacon CDL, so not a separate installer
Header phone 801.486.4884 (Beacon's number) differs from the contact page's 801.972.6611
candidates.reason: A Division 10 distributor that supplies partitions; it joined Beacon CDL in 2019. Installation would go through Beacon, so treat it as the same business as Beacon, not a separate listing.
